name: Experiment 10 Per-Group Local/Global Query Contribution

fixed_evaluation.source: Experiment 2 Stage B document-disjoint artifact reused by Experiments 8 and 9

head_order.ablation_site: attention output immediately before dense W_O

useful_local_group_rule.rule: a local group is useful only if discovery delta is positive, confirmation delta is at least 0.001, and the confirmation paired-bootstrap CI lower bound is above zero

phase_10d_gate.rule: run 10D only if at least one local group passes the frozen useful-local-group rule

phase_10d.construction: exhaust all 8 target local groups times 7 incorrect source chunks; change one local input assignment and leave the other seven aligned

interpretation_limits: single trained seed and one checkpoint
head zeroing and chunk substitution are off-distribution interventions and do not equal retraining
paired sequence confidence intervals do not quantify training-seed uncertainty
single-head damages need not add to the all-local population damage because the network is nonlinear
per-group labels refer to fixed HQ8 GQA positions and are not universal head coordinates
